Method of Attack: Uses a PowerPoint mouse-over technique to trigger a malicious PowerShell script that downloads an encrypted DLL disguised as a JPEG file, which is decrypted and executed to load Graphite malware into memory. Graphite abuses Microsoft Graph API and OneDrive for command and control, allowing remote command execution and loading of additional malware.
Attack Vector: Malicious PowerPoint (.PPT) file with mouse-over hyperlink triggering PowerShell script execution
Use of SyncAppvPublishingServer utility to launch PowerShell
Indicators of Compromise: PowerPoint file with hyperlink triggering PowerShell
JPEG files named DSC0002.jpeg containing encrypted DLLs
Use of rundll32.exe to execute DLL
Use of Microsoft Graph API and OneDrive for C2 communication
Fixed client ID for OAuth2 token acquisition
